correctness.rationale: Exact tanh addition gives the center–difference recurrence. Uniform two-variable analytic Taylor bounds show m reverses sign and d grows by factor between two and four in a small exit tube. A reciprocal-square Gronwall argument with sum(d_k²)=O(delta²) yields w_k~k and sum m_k²=3 log N+O(1) uniformly until the nonlinear first exit. Summing log(d_(k+1)/d_k)=log 3-m_k²/6+O(m_k^4+d_k²) gives log(d_N/epsilon)=N log3-(1/2)log N+O(1). Finite transients extend it to all nonexceptional interior diagonal starts; m=0 is invariant and has the one-term contrast. All error bounds are uniform in epsilon at fixed z,delta. Full proof and standalone finite tests accompany the claim; finite tests are not its proof.
